title: Capture package manifest (multipart field 'manifest' of POST /v1/capture/sessions/{id}/package; images in 'files')

client.description: sdk version, user agent, camera resolution / facing

models_used.description: sha256 of the face and gate models actually run, execution provider

timing.description: started/finished ms, frames processed / dropped, fps

file.description: multipart filename of the ORIGINAL full frame (JPEG) - the recognizer input

detection.description: box [x1,y1,x2,y2], score, schema, keypoints, kp_scores in this image's pixels

signals.description: reserved liveness / anti-replay evidence, recorded but not judged in v1

yaw_trace.description: downsampled [time_s, yaw] of the primary track
